inputs.subject: Help with redecorating my 10-year-old daughter's room — colors & $1,200 budget
inputs.body:
Hi Alara,

I hope you’re well — I’m planning to redecorate my 10-year-old daughter’s bedroom and would love your help as an interior decorator. She loves unicorns, and we’ve decided on the following color scheme and budget:

- Walls: pale lavender
- Curtains: blush pink
- Bed (frame & bedding base): crisp white
- Pillows: pastel mint green
- Budget: $1,200 total

Could you help with sourcing the bed/frame and bedding, selecting unicorn-themed accents (wall art, throw, lamp), and recommending affordable vendors or items that will keep us within the $1,200 budget? I’d also appreciate suggestions for a simple layout, any small furniture pieces we should add, and an estimated timeline and cost breakdown for labor and materials.

Are you available for a short call or an in-home visit next week to review the room and discuss next steps? Please let me know your availability and any initial thoughts or questions.

Thanks so much — looking forward to working with you.

Best,
[Your Name]
